regions.merged_text: With love and with Christmas blessings to all Comes the Infant once more to free us from sorrow Whose love and Whose power and Whose gentleness call To each heart and each soul for a manger tomorrow. Whose love and Whose power and Whose wonders proclaim Him the Son of the Virgin as promised of yore. O, may He estrange us from sin with its shame! And reign in our hearts as His crib evermore!
